_comment: Doc 1 §6.2's intake, replaced post-launch at the user's request. The old ten typed fields are gone, and with them MG-01's ghost-text mechanic (src/minigames/mg01-form.js, deleted -- it was already orphaned: scenes.json mounted it nowhere). Three fields remain, each a binary: one WILLING tile, one NOT WILLING tile, both pre-written by the building. Used only by the S0 application (src/application.js).
_nameNote: Field 1 is a deliberate, documented reversal of the old 'THERE IS NO NAME FIELD' rule (which existed so S2-H's 'Shaun.' could be a name the company was never given). The name is now the first thing the candidate is asked to hand over -- or not. Give it (SHAUN) and S2-C takes it away: 'Ninety-nine.' Withhold it (99) and S2-H hands it back: 'Shaun.' Either way the reveal is the building answering the form. Two or more NOT WILLING answers seed the hostile render -- render only, never score (src/state.js seedRenderFromIntake). canon.text.js asserts this shape; C4 still holds, no field says 'you'.

fields.label: THE CANDIDATE WILL COMPLY WITH INSTRUCTIONS AS ISSUED
